newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Baby shot in Colombian traffic argument.
newsitem.headline: Baby shot in Colombian traffic argument.

text.p: A baby was shot in the head by an irate motorist in the Colombian capital in the second such incident in the last year, local media reported on Monday.

El Tiempo newspaper said the latest shooting occurred on Saturday when a driver got into an argument with Jorge Eliecer Aristizabal, a taxi driver who was travelling with his wife and their 2-year-old son, Jaime Nino.

The unidentified motorist pulled out a pistol during the dispute and fired a single shot through the rear window of Aristizabal's taxi. The bullet lodged in the child's head and he was listed in critical condition at a Bogota hospital on Monday.
In a similiar incident in February of last year a cab driver shot and critically injured a 14-month-old baby during a row in a traffic jam.
"This is yet another demonstration of the intolerance and lack of civic mindedness of Bogotanos," Gen. Teodoro Ocampo, chief of the Metropolitan Police, told El Tiempo of the lastest shooting.
